cues.text: Natsuki turns her back and looks out through the fence.
Natsuki walks past Fuuka and leaves.
Fuuka clasps her hands, eyes shut.
Lucia appears: a masked woman, arms spread, above a glowing dome.
It becomes a new Persona: a mask of eyes, wings of glowing discs.
On the rooftop, a glowing light sinks into Fuuka's hands.
